I am a serious procrastinator. Not lazy. Just a serious procrastinator.

I have this amazing ability to clock how long it will take me to do something, and then I will wait until that window of time has closed down to the amount of time I know it will take me to accomplish the task. And I think I do this because I am a perfectionist in many ways, and if I wait until I only have so much time to do it, it will be impossible for me to fix it over and over and over again until it's right. If I start something early, I will obsess about it until the time it is due, anyway. So, by waiting, it gives me the time that I would only use to be stressed out, and I can do other things. I wish it wasn't this way, but it is. I used to have a philosophy when I was an undergraduate that any assignment could be done during the morning of the day that it was due.
